assertion: Total U.S. federal debt is around $40 trillion.
warehouse_value: $40.05 trillion total public debt outstanding as of 2026-09-11
sql: SELECT record_date, tot_pub_debt_out_amt FROM econ.federal_debt ORDER BY record_date DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

sources.title: Treasury Fiscal Data API — Debt to the Penny

assertion: The federal government ran roughly a $2 trillion deficit in the first 11 months of fiscal 2026, almost the same as the same span in fiscal 2025.
warehouse_value: FY2026 YTD (11 mo.) deficit = $1.966T vs FY2025 YTD (same span) = $1.973T — a 0.4% difference
sql: SELECT record_date, classification_desc, line_code_nbr, current_fytd_rcpt_outly_amt, prior_fytd_rcpt_outly_amt FROM econ.mts_outlays_by_function WHERE line_code_nbr IN ('120','340') AND record_date = DATE '2026-08-31'
